text: Player accounts are designed for individuals actually competing in the tournament. A player account enables users to enter themselves into tournaments, view and manage their tournament registrations, and receive tournament updates.

topic: Coach and Team Manager Account Features
text: Coach or Team Manager accounts are designed for anyone entering and taking care of a group of players. With this account, coaches and team managers can manage team players and group entries, handle team payments and endorsements, and book courts for their squad.

Creating an account is mandatory for every player before they can register for any tournament. A single player account is used for all KL Open tournaments. The account is used for tournament registration, future tournament participation, viewing registrations, receiving updates, and managing your own profile.

topic: Account Creation Rules and Selection Guide
text: Accounts are strictly for players and coaches / team managers only; parents cannot create accounts. If a user has already registered with their email before, they should log in with their existing account instead of creating a new profile. The same login details can be used for TNG, REDtone, and any other tournament hosted by SRAFT KL. When choosing an account type, pick 'Player' if you will be competing on court, and 'Coach / Team Manager' if you are registering other players.

When creating a player account for the REDtone KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026, the following details are required:
- Personal Details: Full Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Nationality (Malaysian or Foreign), Country, State, and optional Association/Club affiliation.
- Identification: NRIC (IC Number) for Malaysian players, or Passport number for foreign players.
- Squash Credentials & Ranking: National Ranking, WSF SPIN Number, AJSS Membership Number, and AJSS Ranking.
- Account Credentials: Username and Password.

When filling out contact information for registration:
- Email Restrictions: Players from China are not allowed to use qq.com email addresses for registration.
- Mobile Contact Number: Must include the appropriate country code. The number provided must be reachable on WhatsApp, as tournament updates may be communicated via WhatsApp.

topic: Coach and Team Manager Account Features
text: Registering for a Coach or Team Manager account for the REDtone squash tournament allows you to register players for tournaments, manage your team's bulk registration and payment, and book group hotel packages and court practice for your squad.

topic: Coach and Team Manager Registration Requirements and Contact Guidelines
text:
To register for a Coach or Team Manager account, applicants must specify their role (Coach or Team Manager) and provide their full name (as per NRIC/Passport), gender, nationality, country, state, club/association, contact email, contact mobile number, username, and password.

Specific guidelines apply to contact details:
- Email Address: Coaches and Team Managers from China cannot use @qq.com email addresses for registration.
- Mobile Number: Mobile numbers must include the country code and must be reachable on WhatsApp, as tournament updates may be sent there.

To register as a player in the tournament system, navigate to the user login page, select the 'I`m a player' card, fill in all required credentials, and complete the registration to gain access to the system.

After logging in, players are brought to a dashboard displaying their user profile information. To edit profile details, click the 'Update Profile' button at the top, make any necessary changes, and click the 'Save' button.

To sign up for a tournament, select 'Tournaments' from the left sidebar to view available events. Click the 'Register' button for the desired tournament, complete all required registration details, and click 'Submit Registration Only'.

During tournament registration, if a player selects 'Yes' for the accommodation package, they will be redirected to an accommodation booking page after submitting their registration. Players can select an accommodation package, enter the required booking details, and click 'Proceed'.
If a player travels by flight to the tournament, they will be directed to the flight details page after accommodation selection. Fill in all flight details and click 'Save' to complete the entry.

The 'My Tournaments' page lists all tournaments a player has registered for. From here, players can edit their registration info, hotel booking details, and flight details as long as the registration has not yet been endorsed or confirmed by an administrator.

Coaches who register once for a tournament under shrafKL do not need to register again for future competitions under shrafKL. Accounts on shrafKL are reserved for coaches, team managers, and players only; parents cannot create accounts under shrafKL.

From the home dashboard left sidebar, coaches can select 'Register Team Players' to access the team registration page. On this page, coaches can add new players, book accommodation packages for players, and reserve court practice slots.

To book a court slot for practice or court testing, select 'Test court booking' from the left sidebar and click 'Book' to navigate to the team registration page. Click 'Book Court Slot', scroll down and click 'View schedule and Book'. In the window that opens, scroll down to select the desired court and time slot, then click 'Book Now'.

Coaches can book group accommodation and hotel packages for players. On the team registration page, select or fill in the accommodation details and click 'Proceed' to update the hotel accommodation booking and move to the payment page.

The 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026 takes place from 1st December to 6th December 2026. The tournament venues are:

Key Eligibility Rules:
- Age cut-off date: 6th December 2026 (the last day of the tournament).
- The event is open to all International and Malaysian players not banned by ASF, WSF, or PSA. Entries must be endorsed by their respective National or State Association.

topic: Player Withdrawal Policy and Penalty Rules
text:
For the 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026:
- Withdrawals prior to status endorsement and closing date must be processed directly via the Tournament Registration Website.
- Withdrawals after player status is endorsed or after the closing date must be notified immediately to SRAFTKL by phone or email (sraft_kl@yahoo.com).
- Entry fees will NOT be refunded for withdrawals made after the closing date.
- Late withdrawals must be accompanied by a Medical Certificate or official supporting documents. Failure to provide valid documentation will result in the player receiving 'zero' ranking points, which will count as one of the player's 4 best results. Valid documentation will be evaluated by SRAFTKL on a case-by-case basis.

topic: Match Rules, Scoring, and Playing Format
text:
Rules and match play regulations for the 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026:
- Match Format: Played under a circuit format. Winners of all rounds play best of 5 games. Losers play best of 3 games. Top 32 positions play best of 5 games until final positions.
- Scoring: 11 Points PAR (Point-A-Rally), following WSF Rules of World Singles Game.
- Eye Protection: Protective eyewear is MANDATORY for all players.
- Punctuality & Walkover: Players/officials must arrive at the venue at least 15 minutes before scheduled match times. A walkover will be awarded if a player is late by 15 minutes when called.
- Duty: Players must mark and referee matches when required.
- Schedule Changes: Matches must be played as scheduled on the draw; the organiser is not obligated to alter match times.
- Check Next Match: Players must verify their next round match details before leaving the venue.

Seeding and prize details for the 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026:
- Seedings & Draws: Initial seedings will be published two (2) weeks before the tournament start date via the registration website. The latest updated ASF Asian Junior Super Series (AJSS) ranking will be used for seeding. Players are advised to include their AJSS and national rankings in their registration form.
- Prizes: Medals and prizes in kind will be awarded to the top 8 winners across all age categories.

topic: Code of Conduct and Disciplinary Violations
text:
All participants in the 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026 are bound by ASF Code of Conduct rules. Offences subject to penalties under Rule 14 or disciplinary action by the ASF Disciplinary & Appeals Committee include:
- Verbal or physical abuse of opponents, markers, referees, officials, spectators, or sponsors.
- Dissent, foul/profane language, or offensive gestures.
- Abuse of playing equipment or courts.
- Failure to comply with entry conditions or clothing/advertising rules.
- Unauthorized withdrawal, failure to attend, or defaulting without proven injury/illness/emergency.
- Failing to complete a match for reasons other than injury/illness.
- Failing to accommodate reasonable media interview requests.
- Unreasonable conduct bringing the game into disrepute (including intoxication by alcohol or substances).

Clothing regulations for the 18th KL International Junior Open Squash Championships 2026 conform to Asian Squash Federation (ASF) standards:
- Men's attire: Short-sleeved shirt, shorts, socks, and non-marking playing shoes.
- Women's attire: Shirt with skirt or shorts, or a dress, socks, and non-marking playing shoes.
- Tracksuits/garments during play require Championship Referee permission.
- All clothing worn during practice and matches must meet host country decency and cultural standards.
- Clothing colors: Any color or color combination is permitted.
- Commercial Logos on Shirts:
  a) Manufacturer trademark: One display on one breast, max 20 sq cm total (max 10 cm in any single dimension).
  b) Sponsor displays: Max 3 sponsor displays (each max 40 sq cm total and max 10 cm in any single dimension) located on opposite breast or sleeves.
